jobs.description:
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
Coupang is seeking an expert to help shape and communicate the company’s perspective on complex public policy, economic, regulatory, and geopolitical issues. This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to senior executives, developing compelling persuasive narratives, op-eds, policy messaging, congressional engagement materials, and executive communications that support Coupang’s business and policy objectives.
The ideal candidate combines exceptional writing ability with deep intellectual curiosity and a sophisticated understanding of US and international public policy, government, politics, and current affairs. They possess the judgment to translate complex policy issues into persuasive and accessible communications for a wide range of audiences, including policymakers, media, business leaders, and external stakeholders.
This role is part of the Global Public Affairs and US Corporate Communications team, and will work closely with Public Policy, Legal, and executive leadership teams to ensure consistent and impactful messaging across a broad range of issues affecting the company.
What You Will Do
Create and evolve compelling narratives that articulate Coupang's positions on complex policy, economic, regulatory, and industry issues in support of the company's public affairs and advocacy efforts.
Develop high-quality opinion pieces, speeches, talking points, briefing materials, policy statements, congressional engagement materials, media content, and executive communications.
Serve as a senior member of the Global Public Affairs team, identifying opportunities to shape policy conversations and strengthen Coupang's external voice.
Maintain a deep understanding of the Washington policy, political, and media landscape, including emerging issues relevant to Coupang's business.
Monitor legislative, regulatory, and public policy developments to identify communications opportunities and potential risks.
Position Coupang executives as thought leaders through persuasive, audience-focused communications and strategic storytelling.
Advise executives on messaging, narrative development, stakeholder engagement, and external communications strategies.
Translate complex policy, regulatory, and economic issues into clear, compelling, and accessible communications for diverse audiences.
Partner closely with Public Policy, Legal, Corporate Communications, and business leaders to develop integrated communications strategies and messaging.
Conduct research and analysis on policy, regulatory, economic, and political issues affecting Coupang and its stakeholders.
Support executive preparation for media engagements, public appearances, policy events, and meetings with key external stakeholders.
Ensure consistency and alignment across corporate, policy, advocacy, and public affairs communications.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree
15+ years of experience in speechwriting, policy communications, executive communications, government communications, journalism, public affairs, or related fields
Exceptional writing and editing skills across a variety of formats and audiences
Experience developing communications for senior executives, elected officials, policymakers, or public sector leaders
Deep understanding of public policy, government institutions, legislative processes, and political environments
Strong track record working with DC with key opinion leader audiences
Experience translating complex policy issues into persuasive communications
Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking capabilities
Ability to manage multiple high-priority assignments in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications
Experience serving as a speechwriter or senior communications advisor to government leaders, senior political appointees, elected officials, cabinet-level executives, or corporate executives
Experience within the White House, Congress, federal agencies, public policy organizations, think tanks, or executive branch departments
Experience in the U.S. Treasury, State Department, Department of Defense, or comparable government institutions
Experience writing for Members of Congress, cabinet officials, governors, or senior corporate executives
Experience as a political, policy, economic, regulatory, or Washington-based journalist
Experience with top-tier national media organizations such as The Washington Post, The New York Times, Politico, Axios, Associated Press, or similar publications
Understanding of technology, e-commerce, trade, economic policy, regulatory policy, or international affairs
Experience operating in highly visible and fast-changing public policy environments
Pay & Benefits
Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation.
The base pay for this position ranges from $148,400/year in our lowest geographic market to $256,520/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.description: At Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS), our mission is to power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy any product they want. We innovate on behalf of our customers to ensure uniqueness and consistency of product identity and to infer relationships between products in Amazon Catalog to drive the selection gateway for the search and browse experiences on the website. We're solving a fundamental AI challenge: establishing product relevant information at unprecedented scale with Frontier Models and Agents. The scale is staggering: billions of products, petabytes of multimodal data, millions of sellers, dozens of languages, and infinite product diversity ranging from electronics to groceries to digital content. The research challenges are immense. GenAI and VLMs hold transformative promise for catalog understanding, but we operate where traditional methods fail: ambiguous problem spaces, incomplete and noisy data, inherent uncertainty, reasoning across both images and textual data, and explaining decisions at scale. Enriching product information requires sophisticated models that reason across text, images, and structured data, all while maintaining accuracy and trust for high-stakes business decisions affecting millions of customers daily. Amazon's Catalog System Services Science team is looking for an innovative and customer-focused applied scientist to help us make the world's best product catalog even better. In this role, you will partner with technology and business leaders to build new state-of-the-art algorithms, models, and services. You will pioneer advanced GenAI solutions that power next-generation agentic shopping experiences, working in a collaborative environment where you can experiment with massive data from the world's largest product catalog, tackle problems at the frontier of AI research, rapidly implement and deploy your algorithmic ideas at scale, across millions of customers. Key job responsibilities - Formulate novel research problems at the intersection of GenAI, multimodal learning, and large-scale information retrieval. In essence, translating ambiguous business challenges into tractable scientific frameworks - Design and implement leading models leveraging frontier models, and agentic architectures to enrich catalog information at billion-product scale - Pioneer explainable AI methodologies that balance model performance with scalability requirements for production systems impacting millions of daily customer decisions - Own end-to-end ML pipelines from research ideation to production deployment, processing petabytes of multimodal data with rigorous evaluation frameworks - Represent the team in the broader science community - publishing findings, delivering tech talks, and staying at the forefront of GenAI, VLM, and agentic system research

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
Central Functions FP&A 팀은 Coupang Central Finance 조직의 핵심 부서로서, 글로벌 법인 전반의 non-tech corporate expenses를 총괄 관리합니다. 우리의 미션은 비용 최적화와 스마트한 자본 배분을 통해 회사의 성장을 견인하는 것입니다. 우리는 전사의 다양한 비즈니스 리더들과 협력하여 효율성 벤치마크를 수립하고, 재무 성과를 지속적으로 추적하며, 전사 비용의 가시성을 제고합니다. 이를 통해 조직의 지출을 최우선 전략 목표와 연계함으로써 경영진의 의사결정을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.
직무 소개
Coupang의 확장되는 글로벌 비즈니스 전반에서 corporate expenses 관리를 주도할 야심 찬 Senior FP&A Analyst를 모십니다.
본 역할은 단순한 전통적 재무 보고 수준을 넘어, 능동적인 비즈니스 파트너이자 문제 해결사로서 기여하게 됩니다. 손익에 영향을 미치는 주요 인풋 지표를 정의 및 모니터링하고, 세부 데이터를 직접 추출하여 깊이 있는 원인 분석을 수행하며, 재무 실적에 반영되기 전 선제적으로 운영 리스크를 포착합니다. 또한, 가공되지 않은 데이터를 신속하고 실행 가능한 리스크 완화 계획으로 전환하여 리더십의 신뢰받는 조언자 역할을 수행하고, Coupang의 수익성 제고 및 장기적인 지속 가능 성장에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다.
현업 인터뷰: 단순한 숫자 검증을 넘어 비즈니스 전략의 파트너로, 쿠팡 FP&A를 만나다
업무 내용
인풋 지표 추적 및 관리: P&L 주요 인풋 지표를 정의·모니터링하고 추세를 수립하며, 이상 징후 발생 시 즉각 리스크를 공유하고 구체적인 실행 계획을 제안
Hands-on 원인 분석: 복잡한 재무 및 운영 데이터를 직접 조회·추출하여 비용 차이 및 운영 비효율에 대한 깊이 있는 원인 분석을 주도
글로벌 전사 비용 관리: 글로벌 법인들의 사업 운영비 (OPEX) 및 자본 지출 (CAPEX)을 End-to-End로 책임지며, 재무적 책임감을 바탕으로 전략적 목표와의 정렬을 도모
비용 최적화 및 ROI 제고: 비즈니스 이해관계자들과 협력하여 실행 가능한 효율성 목표를 설정하고, 비용 절감 기회를 발굴하며, 지출의 효과성을 지속 모니터링하여 ROI를 극대화
전략적 계획 및 추정: 전사 비용 항목에 대한 월간, 분기간, 연간 계획 사이클을 주도하고, 정교한 추정과 실행 가능한 차이 분석을 제공
리포팅 툴 관리: 경영진에게 핵심 정보와 실행 가능한 인사이트를 효율적으로 전달할 수 있도록 경영 리포팅 툴을 개발하고 운영
경영진 의사결정 지원: 복잡한 재무 데이터를 간결하고 전략적인 인사이트 및 실행 가능한 권고사항으로 다듬어 경영진에게 보고
